experimental_design.evidence: inferred: We employed liquid chromatography coupled with tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) using formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) cSCC material to study the tumor and normal skin tissue proteomes.

factor_value.evidence: inferred: Of 1,310 unique proteins identified, expression of an average of 144 and 88 proteins were significantly (p<0.05) increased and decreased, respectively, in the tumor samples compared to their normal counterparts.

number_of_technical_replicates.evidence: Peptides (2 μg) were loaded in triplicate at a flow rate of 200 nl/min onto a C18-reversed phase column with mobile phase buffers A (2% acetonitrile (ACN)/0.1% FA) and B (80% ACN/0.1% FA), over a 2- h linear gradient (2-45% B for 118 min; 45-80% B for 1 min, 80% B for 1 min).
